scope: Dry flume/tow-tank scaled experiment only; not coastal installation or grid demonstration
requirements_before_sizing: Select and document tank cross-section/water depth and marine-rated equivalent rig; calculate blockage and safe swept clearance
Review hydraulic/fluid load envelope from prospective test setpoints, including shutdown/transient conditions
Size frame, anchors, load cells, shaft torque meter, couplings, fuses and dump/load bank by an independent licensed equipment engineer against test limits
Separate rotor tests by architecture and report different capture-area definitions, identical upstream control-volume and metered auxiliary power
baseline_electricity_requirements: Net measured delivered load-side electricity; all motor/actuator/PTO parasitics separately measured; no assumption of positive net export

systems.name: Modular non-powered lockable support frame with interchangeable rotor/foil fixtures
systems.gate: Strength, blockage, safe removal and containment reviewed

systems.name: Shaft torque/rotary angle transducer with stated uncertainty and calibration certificate
systems.gate: Bandwidth/peak range and phase response selected from predicted transients

systems.name: Independent streamwise and cross-stream multi-axis support load-cell
systems.gate: Independent zero/reversal calibration and safety load case

systems.name: Blade-root full bridge strain-gauge circuits (two critical axes per tested blade)
systems.gate: Material-specific strain-stress transfer calibrated; water protection

systems.name: Strut / mooring / frame instrumented load path
systems.gate: Separate shaft/strut loads to avoid inferring blade stress from support drag

systems.name: Shaft angle absolute or quadrature encoder with index pulse
systems.gate: Measured phase alignment and timing jitter uncertainty

systems.name: Upstream 3-D current/velocity instrument (ADV or source-qualified ADCP) with calibration
systems.gate: Measured local inflow, shear and turbulence; not tidal height proxy

systems.name: Fluid temperature, pressure/depth and density/source sampling
systems.gate: Characterize viscosity, blockage and submergence under reversal

systems.name: Swappable generator / electrical PTO and protected DC conversion for rotating geometries
systems.gate: Measured mechanical in and electric out; no assumed conversion efficiency

systems.name: Independent metering of load-side three-phase or DC volts/amps/watts and direction
systems.gate: Record signed delivered electricity including negative draw

systems.name: Actuator/controller/auxiliary independent power metering
systems.gate: Account active pitch, braking, pumping, telemetry and platform loads

systems.name: Overvoltage / overcurrent protected programmable load bank or dissipative dump
systems.gate: Sizing based on worst credible fault; no unreviewed shore/grid connection

systems.name: Single-clock synchronized multi-channel differential DAQ with sufficient strain/encoder/force inputs
systems.gate: Traceable anti-alias, timing and sensor sample rates derived from natural frequencies

systems.name: Onboard timestamped raw recorder with source hashes and unaltered channels
systems.gate: Document trial ids, dropped records, filter chain and chain of custody

systems.name: Accessible dual-path emergency-stop and motor/PTO de-energizing isolation
systems.gate: Witnessed dry test with fail-safe behavior for jam, sensor loss and power loss

systems.name: Exclusion-zone shrouds, physical restraint, guarded drives and independent overspeed trip
systems.gate: Stop all personnel access while energized; written risk assessment

systems.name: Ground-fault protection, sealed connectors, safe lifting and tagged retrieval points
systems.gate: Water/electrical inspection and deenergized recovery procedure

systems.name: Visual/acoustic environmental baseline sensors as permitted by test venue
systems.gate: Baseline fish/noise data and thresholds, not omitted because flume test initially

systems.name: Interchangeable axial/crossflow/foil manufactured test articles and inspected material coupons
systems.gate: No fabrication without verified rig interface, uncertainty/strength review

systems.name: Versioned material, seals, bearings, corrosion and reusable/recyclable component log
systems.gate: Independent manufacturing and disposal gate

costing.notes: Quantities are provisional engineering placeholders, not a purchase list or cost estimate. Obtain venue, load capacities, qualified component specifications and at least 2 independent quotes before budget.

safety_go_nogo: Document operator/venue acceptance and trained supervision
Witness emergency shutoff and measured overspeed shutdown
Calibrate phase/clock, force, torque, strain and electrical meters
De-risk short low-flow operation behind guards before any incremental setpoint
Document fisheries/DFO/NS/Transport/Mi'kmaq/access/site permissions separately before any in-water field test
